blurb: Guests can rent premium Sea Ray bowriders and Crest pontoon boats to explore Lake George. Rentals include a safety briefing and orientation, with life jackets provided. Winter storage and boat winterization services are also offered.
extraNote: Weather cancellations at discretion; full refund or reschedule with no charge · $500 deposit required at time of rental via credit card · Full refund less $50 processing fee for cancellations · Late returns incur additional charges and may affect other bookings · Early pickup or late return may be available by special arrangement with additional fees · Owners must have adequate hull and liability insurance for winter storage; marina not liable except for negligence · 36 Sagamore Road, Bolton Landing, NY
